variants.title: Quantum Hall effect in graphene: half-integer plateaus
variants.sample: Graphene Hall bar on hBN, n = 2e15 per m^2 (SIMULATED)
variants.method: B sweep to 9 T at 1.5 K and 300 mK
variants.unknown: Hall plateaus h/(nu e^2) with nu = 2, 6, 10; density; mobility
variants.note: Graphene's fourfold-degenerate Landau levels include one at zero energy shared by electrons and holes, so the plateaus fall at nu = 4(k + 1/2) = 2, 6, 10: the first at h/(2e^2) = 12906 ohm. Density and mobility are illustrative.

source.title: K. S. Novoselov et al., Nature 438, 197 (2005); Y. Zhang et al., Nature 438, 201 (2005)
source.note: the density and mobility are illustrative
